APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and Other Events (2)

November 19, 2026

[Provisional translation]

On November 19, 2026 (local time), Prime Minister Takaichi, who was visiting Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China, to attend the APEC (Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation) Economic Leaders’ Meeting and other events, participated in a family photo session, followed by the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. Lastly, she held a press conference for domestic and international media regarding her attendance at the ASEAN-related Summit Meetings and the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and other matters.
